newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse says cancelled 55 members in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse says cancelled 55 members in 1996.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange last year cancelled membership of 55 companies, mostly units of banks, in line with Beijing's efforts to drive bank funds out of stock markets, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
This reduced the number of the exchange's members to 524 by the end of 1996, 30 less than at the end of 1995.
China's Commercial Bank Law promulgated in 1995 bans commercial banks from investing funds in the stock market, and most banks have since closed or sold their securities subsidiaries.
